newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet jumps higher, trails sharp NYMEX gains.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet jumps higher, trails sharp NYMEX gains.

text.p: Spot jet fuel prices rallied sharply Monday, tracking the steep climb in NYMEX heating oil futures prices.
Fears cold weather this week will squeeze heat supplies drove the NYMEX higher, keeping many cash market traders on the sidelines, with buyers reluctant to chase prices up.
"There were sellers all around, but no buyers came out," one trader said.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade jet fuel was offered Monday at 2.00 cents under the screen, about 0.25 cent down from Friday, while 55-grade on the Gulf was offered at 1.20 cents under.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
